meta: Asked AI to compare 3 phone plans and got 5 long paragraphs, and still don't know which to pick? Say exactly how you want the answer. Output format: "Answer in a table: Plan | Price | Data | Who it suits".

muc.title: Tired eyes
muc.text: Mark asks AI to compare three phone plans and gets back five long paragraphs. After reading, he still doesn't know which plan to pick.

muc.title: Say exactly how to answer
muc.text: Bit says: specify the output format. Add: answer in a table, with columns for plan name, price, data and who it suits. One table, and you can choose at a glance.

muc.title: A format for every task
muc.text: Each task has its format: a table to compare, a checklist for to-dos, three bullet points for a summary, an email with a subject line to send.

muc.title: Set a limit
muc.text: Add a length limit: under a hundred words, or readable in thirty seconds. AI will cut the extra parts on its own.

muc.title: When it goes to another program
muc.text: If the result goes on into a spreadsheet or another app, ask for JSON or CSV format, so you can paste it right in.

muc.title: Give it a blank template
muc.text: The strongest trick: paste a blank template for AI to fill in, like the sample examples in part one.

muc.title: Compare with a table
muc.text: Next time you need to compare two things you're thinking of buying, ask AI to answer in a table, plus one line saying which to choose.
